quarterly_data.quarter: X-Energy press release: X-energy, Amazon, American Electric Power Partner to Bring (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: X-energy and American Electric Power announced a Joint Development Agreement to advance feasibility work for a proposed 960 MW Xe-100 SMR project in Indiana - a 12-unit Xe-100 plant near the former site of the retired Breed Generating Station in Sullivan County, on an AEP-owned brownfield site - with Amazon providing certain (milestone-based) project development funding. X-energy says it is the second commercial deployment under X-energy and Amazon's collaboration aimed at bringing more than 5 GW of new nuclear capacity to the U.S. grid by 2039 (joining Energy Northwest's Cascade Advanced Energy Facility in Washington State), and its third announced commercial U.S. Xe-100 project and fourth announced worldwide within its approximate 11.5 GW commercial pipeline.
quarterly_data.figure: 960 MW, 12-unit plant; more than 5 GW by 2039 (Amazon collaboration); approximate 11.5 GW commercial pipeline

quarterly_data.quarter: X-Energy press release: X-energy, Amazon, American Electric Power Partner to Bring (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: X-energy's first Xe-100 deployment - a proposed four-unit plant that would provide both electricity and high-temperature industrial steam to a Dow manufacturing site on the Texas Gulf Coast under the U.S. Department of Energy's Advanced Reactor Demonstration Program - is in the final phases of the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission's review of its construction permit application. The Xe-100 is an 80 MWe high-temperature gas-cooled reactor, helium-cooled and powered by TRISO fuel.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: customer (host site of the proposed first Xe-100 plant)
